title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
description: Creates 25 AI agents in a Sims-like virtual town, each with memories, plans, and social relationships. Introduces a memory architecture with recency/importance/relevance retrieval, reflection (periodically synthesize memories into higher-level insights), and planning (daily schedules derived from character background). Agents exhibit emergent social behavior.
authors: Park, O'Brien, Cai, Morris, Liang, Bernstein (Stanford)
